cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll open the landlord's letter together. First, tell me the worst it could mean for Dad's shop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've only missed one payment. Let me read it to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll let you read it. But say the worst first, before we know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what would that make me, after he trusted me with it? Say that too, then you can open it.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries reassurance and offers to read, a useful alternative to fearful speculation.
